## Validation

## Review
- [ ] Reviewed Files changed.
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, or private customer/merchant data.
- [ ] Relevant validation recorded above.
- [ ] For website changes: checked mobile layout and accessibility, or explained gaps.
- [ ] Identified how to revert if needed.
- [ ] Any production deployment has separate authorization.
